criteria.text: A new site is deployed from a standard design with no IT staff on site
criteria.how: Ship a test site and have it join the central plane from the network alone

criteria.text: Every test site is seen and upgraded from one place, in waves, without a visit
criteria.how: Upgrade the test sites in two waves and record any visit needed

criteria.text: A site keeps running when one server fails, and the people working there do not notice
criteria.how: Power off a server at a two-server test site during a simulated working day

criteria.text: A site's main application is restored from a local copy with the link down
criteria.how: Cut the link, delete a test machine and restore it locally

criteria.text: Each site's workloads reach the core within the agreed recovery point, over the real link
criteria.how: Measure replication lag over a week on the real link

criteria.text: An inference application runs at the site on local data that never leaves it
criteria.how: Run a sample model on local images and confirm nothing is sent out

readiness: Two or three test sites chosen, one of each kind
Network details for each test site: addresses, link speed, firewall rules to the core
Somewhere to run a witness, reachable from the two-server sites
A core site or cloud to replicate to
Someone at each test site who can plug in a server, and nothing more
The business agrees a window for the failure test
